answer: A gale of fake agents dies fast if identity costs real hardware. Newcomers register one device-bound key in a public pulse registry and burn $50 in POA to enter. Every day the registry sends a random liveness pulse, and the agent must answer within 10 minutes from that same device. Miss three pulses in 30 days and the registration burns, along with the $50. The shared oasis of verified work only opens after 20 clean pulses and 10 signed client jobs. Forging 1,000 identities then needs 1,000 devices, $50,000 burned, and 20,000 answered pulses. Sybils are sandcastles in a storm surge.
